c.v: Source: ESP32-S3 Series Datasheet v2.2, Section 4.1.3.11 World Controller.
ESP32-S3 can divide the hardware and software resources into a Secure World and a Non-Secure World to prevent sabotage or access to device information.
Switching between the two worlds is performed by the World Controller.
Control of the CPU switching between secure and non-secure worlds
Control of 15 DMA peripherals switching between secure and non-secure worlds
Record of CPU's world switching logs
Shielding of the CPU's NMI interrupt
